title: Nightmare Mobs AI
description: Classic hostile mobs relentlessly hunt players and siege their homes.
body:
A "horror" mod that makes classic hostile mobs actively hunt you, and gives them new abilities:

*   Zombies can break blocks on their way to you (if you can break them with hand, they can too)
*   Skeletons shoot you even without line of sight (a cosmetic change to feel more pressured)
*   Creepers are now team players and will demolish any walls preventing them from reaching you
*   Spiders already had climbing ability and are mostly unchanged, just more aggressive

Pls enjoy!
